A community shaped by Canyon Park

Fifteen neighbourhoods are planned around a continuous green landscape. More than 35 km of walking, jogging and cycling routes will connect parks, homes and community destinations.

A garden of your own

Aliso brings three- and four-bedroom townhouses to walkable residential streets. Private gardens extend family life beyond the living room.

Townhouse collection

Aliso townhouses

Aliso offers 3- and 4-bedroom townhouses with private gardens. The garden opens off the living space, giving children room to play within sight of the house and giving the family another place to gather for dinner.

Which Aliso layout fits your family?

Start with how you use the rooms each day. A three-bedroom home can keep everyone close, while a fourth bedroom gives you flexibility for guests or a home office. Compare garden orientation and the walk to the nearest park when choosing a plot.

Villa collection

Rancho villas

Rancho brings 4- and 5-bedroom detached villas to Palm Springs. Living and dining areas open towards gardens, courtyards and pools, so a weekend lunch can move outdoors without taking everyone away from the heart of the home.

Space to host, room to retreat

The distinction here is privacy as much as size. En-suite bedrooms give family members space of their own. When comparing villas, look at the relationship between the main living room, the courtyard and the pool to find the layout you would use most.

Parks and clubs

Follow the water through Canyon Park

Streams, sensory gardens and shaded paths are planned through the heart of the community. Step out for a morning walk or take the longer route home through the gardens.

Thousand Palms Country Club

A beach-style pool, wellness spaces and restaurants are planned together, making it easy to move from a swim to lunch with friends.

Silver Spur Racquet Club

Racquet courts, fitness facilities and pools are planned for the sports club, giving residents a place to play a match or swim after a workout.

A day at Palm Springs

Southern Dubai

Where is Palm Springs in Dubai?

Palm Springs sits on the mainland beside Palm Jebel Ali. Sheikh Zayed Road connects this part of Jebel Ali with the rest of Dubai, while Al Maktoum International Airport serves the southern corridor.

Plan the journeys that matter to you

For a household with work in Dubai South or Jebel Ali, the southern location is worth a closer look. Compare the route from your preferred neighbourhood to work, school and the airport when shortlisting a home.
